note: Warzone Season 1 perks and equipment, and three sources' picks. Read by hand on 2026-11-07. Perks, slots and effects are Activision's. Tiers and combos are each site's own.
perks: Faster revives that restore full health, for you and the ally. More health while downed.
Shows enemy footprints and nearby enemies, warns when you are targeted, outlines enemies you damage.
A kill briefly reveals the rest of that squad. Shows enemies using Buy Stations or Contracts.
Shorter radar reveals and Hunter outlines, no standard pings on you, slower enemy traps.
One extra lethal and tactical, more explosive damage, full ammo when you pick up a loadout.
Less fall damage and no landing stun, faster climbing, a combat roll.
Faster sprint-to-fire while fully plated, faster movement with plates missing.
Faster squad sprint. Long sprints start health regeneration.
Enemies you kill drop ammo, equipment, plates and cash for your squad.
Faster plating, equipment throws and crate captures, a speed boost while plating.
Faster ADS, weapon swap and reload for a short time after a kill.
Faster health regeneration start, resists flash, stun and shock, less explosive damage, no knockdown.
A kill or a plate starts health regeneration at once.
Two plates refill your armor, not three.
Cheaper squad redeploys, and redeploys fire no visible flare.
elite: Better strafing and crouching, smaller ADS penalties while jumping and sliding.
Undetectable by enemy recon killstreaks, equipment and perks.
lethal: Lethal on impact to unarmored targets or with a headshot.
Proximity mine that now also hits a small area around itself.
Launches and detonates in the air. Sticks to passing vehicles.
Throwable trap. Several can be linked into one network.
Sticky incendiary that hurts vehicles and armored targets.
Leaves burning pools where it lands.
Burrows through a surface before it explodes.
tactical: Starts health regeneration, boosts movement, refreshes Tactical Sprint.
Shows nearby enemies on a tablet.
Reveals nearby enemies where they stood.
Slows enemy reactions and blurs vision.
Sticky trap that shocks enemies and disrupts equipment and vehicles.
Proximity mine that suppresses and marks enemies.
